上限 2000 字符。支持 Markdown；@everyone 之类要频道允许: Up to 2000 characters. Markdown supported; mentions like @everyone only work if the channel allows them
删掉本 Webhook（或本 Bot）自己发的消息: Deletes a message sent by this webhook (or this bot) itself
十六进制，如 #2b6cb0；留空用 Discord 默认: Hex color, e.g. #2b6cb0; leave blank to use Discord's default
填了就带一张嵌入卡片: If filled in, an embed card is attached
如 http://127.0.0.1:7897；部署环境直连不了 discord: E.g. http://127.0.0.1:7897; required when the deployment environment can't reach discord.com directly
常放来源与时间: Commonly used for source and time
往频道发一条消息，可带嵌入卡片与附件: Sends a message to a channel, optionally with an embed card and attachments
往频道发消息。免费、无审批，建一个 Webhook 只要频道管理员点几下。: Sends messages to a channel. Free, no approval needed — a channel admin can create a webhook in a few clicks.
查一次 Webhook 是否还在。ok=false 表示它被删了或地址不对: Checks whether the webhook still exists. ok=false means it was deleted or the URL is wrong
消息发在话题里时要给: Required when the message was sent in a thread
覆盖 Webhook 自带的名字（仅 Webhook 模式）: Overrides the webhook's own name (webhook mode only)
论坛频道/话题的 id；留空发到频道本身: Forum channel/thread ID; leave blank to send to the channel itself
键值对，如 {\"标的\":\"600519\",\"评级\":\"买入\"}；: Key-value pairs, e.g. {"symbol":"600519","rating":"buy"}; laid out as two columns in the card
随消息上传的文件（图片会直接显示）: Files uploaded with the message (images are displayed inline)
频道设置 → 整合 → Webhook → 新建，复制那条 https://di: Channel settings → Integrations → Webhooks → New, then copy the https://discord.com/api/webhooks/... URL. **It is itself the credential** (anyone who has it can send messages), so keep it secret
